apps.name: OpenNOW Metal 4
apps.localizedDescription: Build 189 removes the nonworking Mobile Game preset, aim/fire button, sprint/rim marker and floating movement/look indicators. Saved Mobile Game selections migrate to Standard without resetting other settings. Retains Standard/split-touchpad and GeForce NOW controls with independent layout editing, vibration/shortcuts, immersive mode, optional HUD metrics and Sessions history. Metal 4 rendering/stutter fixes, 2560×1080 near-native MetalFX and the upstream iOS merge remain unchanged. Device Release archive passed; 222 parity tests passed, one hardware-only skip. Unsigned IPA for KravaSigner.
